currentContext.expansion: Advani Hotels & Resorts operates a single hotel unit and its expansion activity in FY 2025-26 is confined to that property rather than new sites. Management states it is refurbishing 62 guestrooms in one of the Wings to current international standards, positioning this as an advantage over building new hotels given that the cost of land, construction and furnishing for new hotels has risen. Separately, because large weddings require an alternate venue in addition to the Company's beachfront lawns, the Company has initiated the process of building a larger banquet hall, which management says will also be useful for larger conferences especially in the monsoon months. Both items are stated as in-progress / initiated — no commissioning date, completion timeline or project cost is disclosed in this bundle. External infrastructure that management cites as supportive (improved Goa road network, the nearing-completion Dabolim Airport terminal expansion, and Ro-Ro trains from Mumbai to Goa commencing in December) is third-party capex, not the Company's own. The Company reports no Subsidiary, Joint Venture or Associate Company during the year, and no capital assets were created or acquired through CSR spend.
